text_blocks.snippet: Common and serious side effects of Jardiance (empagliflozin) are tied to how the medication helps your kidneys remove excess sugar through your urine.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning, urgency, frequent urination, or abnormal urine appearance.
Genital yeast infections: Fungal infections causing thick white discharge, itching, burning, pain, or swelling in vaginal or genital areas (affecting both women and men).
Increased urination: Needing to pee more often or getting up overnight.
Increased thirst or mild dehydration: Feeling thirstier than usual.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A life-threatening buildup of acid in the blood (can occur even with normal blood sugar levels). Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual fatigue, trouble breathing, or fruity-smelling breath.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Excessive fluid loss that can cause dizziness, lightheadedness, or fainting when standing up.

Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier's gangrene): A rare, severe, and life-threatening bacterial infection of the perineum (area between the genitals and anus) causing intense pain, swelling, redness, and fever.
Hypoglycemia (low blood sugar): Most common if Jardiance is taken alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Serious kidney infections: UTIs that spread to the kidneys (pyelonephritis) or blood (urosepsis).
Lower limb amputations: An increased risk reported primarily in patients with a history of amputation, peripheral vascular disease, or foot ulcers.
Severe allergic reactions: Hives or swelling of the face, lips, and throat leading to trouble breathing or swallowing.
